name: Wasatch Container
old_description: Wasatch Container is Utah’s premier provider of integrated case and foam packaging solutions.
about:
Wasatch Container operates from North Salt Lake, Utah, where it was founded in 1995 by Jerry Frisch, a University of Wisconsin‑Stout packaging engineering graduate. The company began as a modest brown‑box manufacturer and remains family‑owned, with Frisch joined by his children Ryan Frisch and Lauren Frisch in leadership roles.

Today the firm runs three specialized manufacturing facilities in the Salt Lake City area totaling more than 225,000 square feet and employs over 85 people. Its core output includes custom corrugated boxes, point‑of‑purchase displays, protective foam inserts, wood crates, and rugged transport cases. In‑house capabilities span structural and graphic design, prepress, 3D rendering, digital sample cutting, die‑cutting, foam converting, fabricating, finishing, assembly, and fulfillment services such as kitting, e‑commerce packing, and U.S./Canada shipping.

The customer base covers telecommunications, industrial, medical, and aerospace shipping applications, as well as e‑commerce and retail brands requiring UN‑certified packaging, stock boxes, or high‑value product protection. Clients range from companies needing single‑run prototypes to those managing ongoing supply programs.

Wasatch Container emphasizes a collaborative four‑step process — Design & Discovery, Transparent Pricing, Production & Precision, and Ongoing Support — and highlights its award‑winning design team, full in‑house converting, and integrated case‑and‑foam approach as key differentiators.
